I could not recall J&J's reported cost of products sold for each 2025 quarter, so this is an estimate rather than a figure taken from the filings.

- **Sales:** Fiscal 2025 sales were about $94.2 billion. By quarter, that was roughly $21.9B, $23.7B, $24.0B and $24.6B.
- **Gross margin:** I assumed about 69%, based on J&J's recent gross margins of roughly 69–71%. That implies cost of products sold of about $29.3 billion for the year.
- **Gross profit:** That leaves about $64.9 billion for the year.
- **Quarterly average:** $64.9 billion divided by four quarters is about $16.2 billion.

The result depends on the gross margin assumption, so treat it as approximate.
